subject: computer-science
intro: Computer science feeds the industry that builds and protects software: writing it, testing it, storing the data behind it and defending it — plus the research frontier where computing itself is invented.

roles.title: Software Developers
roles.what: Research, design and develop computer and network software or specialised utility programs: analyse user needs, build software solutions applying principles of computer science and mathematical analysis, and enhance existing systems.
roles.where: The programming unit's concepts, arrays and file handling are the raw material; the algorithm-design unit's trace tables and debugging discipline is how developers test and amend code; the databases and SQL unit completes the toolkit.

roles.title: Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers
roles.what: Develop and execute software tests to identify problems and their causes, document defects in a bug tracking system, report them to developers, and join design reviews to comment on requirements and product designs.
roles.where: The algorithm-design unit's test data, trace tables and debugging topics are QA's daily bread — the dry-run discipline you learn here becomes the systematic test planning the role demands.

roles.title: Information Security Analysts
roles.what: Plan, implement, upgrade or monitor security measures protecting computer networks and information: assess vulnerabilities for security risks, propose and implement mitigations, and respond to breaches and viruses.
roles.where: The cyber security topics in the internet unit, plus encryption from the data transmission unit, are the foundations of the role; Boolean logic underpins the access rules and packet filtering analysts configure.

roles.title: Database Architects
roles.what: Design strategies for enterprise databases, data warehouse systems and multidimensional networks; model and construct large relational databases, set standards for operations, queries and security, and refine performance.
roles.where: The databases unit teaches single-table design, data types, primary keys and querying with SQL — the relational model and schema thinking the architect scales up to warehouse infrastructure.

roles.title: Computer and Information Research Scientists
roles.what: Conduct research into fundamental computer and information science as theorists, designers or inventors, developing solutions to problems in computer hardware and software and innovative uses for new computing technology.
roles.where: The syllabus's theory strand — data representation, Boolean logic, computer architecture — plus the automated and emerging technologies unit on robotics and artificial intelligence is the launch pad for computing research.
